source: INHERITED, NOT RE-VERIFIED. Carried from the orchestration-quality-control host capability matrix dated 2026-09-04 and its shipped .cursor agent files. The Claude row of that same matrix was found wrong on 2026-09-07, so re-verify against Cursor's own documentation before relying on a disclosure produced from these rows.

explicit_model.verified: Takes inherit or a model id; unset inherits, so it is always written.

reasoning_effort.verified: Not a separate key: effort rides inside the model string as model-id[effort=level]. The renderer therefore writes one composite value, and effort_map folds xhigh and max onto high.

tool_allowlist.verified: No per-agent tool allowlist is documented. A tool grant renders as an instruction plus an unenforced disclosure.

read_only_enforced.verified: readonly: true is a host-enforced flag, not an instruction.

scoped_hooks.verified: No per-agent hook mechanism is documented.
